svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. 16 mm long: a 4 mm hub, then three 1.5 mm flanges of 14 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: diameter with two 3.75 mm wide grooves on a 10 mm core between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore: 4 mm D-shape to suit the motor shaft, through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hub: drill 2.5 mm across and tap M3 for a set screw onto the shaft flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each groove: a 1 mm hole through the core near one flange to tie the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line: the rear groove for the extensor line, the front for the flexor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: hub 0.5 mm in front of the bulkhead; set screw on the shaft flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The extensor line leaves the top of its groove and the flexor line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom of its groove, both toward the side wall, to the idlers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flanges run true; the spool slides on the shaft without play.
